page.overview:
Who is Hashmal?

Hashmal (90px), also known as Hashmalum, is the fifth Lucavi demon whom Ramza Beoulve must fight. He is the mastermind behind the actions of his vessel, Folmarv Tengille, thus he could be considered the true main antagonist of Final Fantasy Tactics. Second-in-command of the Lucavi, Hashmal is associated with the Leo auracite.

Hashmal is one of the Lucavi, a supernatural demonic race originating from another dimension connected to the world of Ivalice. Although it is uncertain whether he participated in his leader Ultima's initial effort to sow chaos in Ivalice during the prevailing period of the Holy Ydoran Empire, according to the legend of the Zodiac Braves, she intended to gather her companions through the auracites that Ultima supposedly created through her host, Ajora Glabados. However, she was ultimately prevented from achieving her goal due to Ajora's capture and execution due to her treacherous disciple, Germonique.

1200 years after Ultima's defeat and imprisonment within the body of her vessel, the twelve auracites that Saint Ajora and his disciples were said to have wielded as the Zodiac Braves have been scattered throughout Ivalice, which was once again at war, this time between two duchies vying for the throne and control of the kingdom. Because the Church of Glabados had distorted the story of Ajora's life to conceal his true nature, his devotees were unaware of the Stones' ability to possess their bearers.

At some point, Hashmal possessed Folmarv Tengille of the Knights Templar after he obtained the Leo Stone, although the circumstances of how this happened, and for how long he was under Hashmal's influence, are unknown. Having assumed leadership of the remaining Lucavi in Ultima's ​absence, Hashmal led them with the intention of resurrecting her, believing if they could accomplish this, they would no longer need auracite or the receptacles they inhabited to travel between their worlds. The ritual to resurrect Ultima was complex: it needed a suitable host, who would need to be brought to the Airship Graveyard, a dark place in the remote necrohol of Mullonde, accessible only through a portal in the deeps of Orbonne Monastery. Finally, to bring Ultima back demanded an immense shedding of blood. To meet this particular requirement, Hashmal used his influence over the Church through Folmarv to orchestrate the War of the Lions while also searching for the remaining Zodiac Stones and gave some of those he had found to potential vessels who could be possessed by his brethren so they could help him with his plans.
